observations.description: No network/credential/live/scheduler imports. Only dataclass, datetime, hashlib, json, pathlib, paper_gateway, paper_session_supervisor used. trading_authority=False in DrillReportV1 default and all run_recovery_drills output.
Bounded runner: executes exact cycles when healthy, stops on first non-HEALTHY (break), empty cycles rejects with ValueError, no false success after halt.
Context-manager: supervisor __enter__/__exit__ releases lock on success and exception. No cross-delete (second owner cannot release first owner's lock).

DrillReportV1 is frozen, observations in deterministic execution order, report_id=sha256(payload), observation name/passed/reason participate in identity, changing material observation changes report_id, replay identical.
Healthy-cycle drill: runs a bounded healthy cycle and verifies state is HEALTHY. Health file confirms HEALTHY state.
Stale/future drills: stale input (6s ago) halts with kill_switch+disconnect, future input (1us ahead) halts with kill_switch. Both produce persisted kill_switch in health file.
Restart: first session runs healthy, second session with different ID loads existing checkpoint → connected=False, reconciliation_required=True. Checkpoint file confirms.
Ownership contention: second owner acquire() rejected, first owner's lock intact, contention not represented as passing healthy.
Controlled stop: stop request bound to session '5'*32, stop=True+trading_authority=False, final state is STOPPED, checkpoint and health evidence retained.
Corrupted checkpoint: writing corrupt bytes then loading rejects with exception, not assumed clean. Drill observation passed=True means rejection was correctly detected.
Failure injection: lock failure (pre-existing lock) raises, cycle failure (stale input) produces non-HEALTHY, no success after exception, all paths in drill root.
Path containment: all subdirectories under root. Pre-existing root rejects (mkdir without exist_ok). Repeated deterministic execution produces identical results.
Invalid timestamps: naive now rejects (PaperSessionError UTC), non-UTC now rejects, naive observed rejects. All via supervisor.cycle _utc validation.
No skipped/short-circuited passed: all observations have reason and bool passed. Corrupt-checkpoint drill passed=True means rejection correctly detected (not silently assumed clean).

accepted_after_correction: test_observations_ordered (corrected: observations in deterministic execution order, not sorted — verify same order across runs)
test_pre_existing_root_rejects (corrected: run_recovery_drills calls mkdir without exist_ok — pre-existing root correctly rejects with FileExistsError)
test_report_immutable (corrected: use tmp_path instead of static path that persists across runs)
redundant: Some adversarial tests overlap with existing on bounded runner, empty cycles, no network, determinism
